note: Starter island landform (docs/08), built by src/world/terrain/landform.js for chunks chunkMin..chunkMax. Islands made before the keeper's camp update keep this land; new ones grow from starter-island-2.json. Its camp block is not in the base (inBase false): the pad is stamped on an older island's first load (docs/future/13 section 3.8). Meters, Y-up, sea level 0. radius: coast distance from the center before noise. Shore profile: a smooth ramp from the waterline up to plateauHeight over inlandWidth, and down to seabedDepth over seaFallWidth, meeting the waterline at beachSlope (rise per meter). coast: noise that wobbles the coastline (amount in meters). warp: domain warp of the shape fields (strength in meters). detail: gentle fbm bumps on land (amplitude in meters). rise: the central hill (its peak is about plateauHeight + height). basin: a pond hollow with a flat floor at floor meters above sea level. jitter: how far the seed may move the rise or basin center. Everything beyond falloffEnd meters from the center is exactly seabedDepth. materials: sand below sandLow fading to grass by sandHigh (heights in meters, jittered by noise), soil patches where soil noise passes soilLow..soilHigh, rock outcrops only above rockMinHeight where rock noise passes rockLow..rockHigh.

spring.note: The starter spring (docs/07): fromBasinM meters from the basin center toward the rise, so its stream runs down into the pond hollow. rateLps in liters per second (12: a small brook). channel: the gentle grassy swale the stream has cut from the spring to the pond (width and depth in meters), with a narrow rounded bed (thalweg) along its middle where the water gathers; bedGravel is how much of the bed is washed gravel and pebbles (the gravelly soil layer); meanderM swings it sideways in `bends` full bends, plus the domain warp. Keep bank slopes under the steep-rock angle (terrain.json steepRockDeg), and keep the meander small on steep ground: water follows the fall line and leaves a channel that crosses it. headTaper: share of the run over which the bed fades in from nothing at the spring (0: full depth from the start, under the outcrop's pool). outcrop: the small rock outcrop the water wells up from, all from the terrain seed: stones (count range) on a horseshoe arcDeg wide centered uphill (turned up to turnDeg, each stone's angle jittered by angleJitter of its share), ringM (+- ringJitterM) from the spring; radiusM and heightM ranges, stretched up to 1 + elongate along a random axis, set sinkM into the ground, outline and top roughened by lump at lumpScale cycles per meter; the pool reaches poolRadiusM from the spring and holds water poolDepthM deep at the middle, floored with poolGravel gravel; it is leveled so its water stands lipRiseM above the meadow where the notch (notchWidthM wide, downhill) crosses its rim, which stands rimAboveM over the still water (the flow over the sill stands a few cm higher: about 6 cm at 12 L/s over a 0.6 m notch) for rimWidthM (keep it at least one 0.5 m water cell, or the water grid sees no rim) and then falls away at apronSlope (rise per meter; keep it under the steep-rock angle), except over a band spillwayWidthM wide down the bed's line, where the sill drops into the bed down a ramp of spillSlope along the notch, so the spill stays in the channel. Stones are painted rock (boulder scan on top, rock face on steep sides).

camp.note: The keeper's camp (docs/future/13 section 3; src/world/camp). Read it through campOf() in src/world/terrain/landform.js, which gives world meters. inBase: the pad is levelled into this land's base (false: stamped on an older island's first load instead). x, z: pad center (m from the island's center). facingDeg: null faces outward from the island's center; a number overrides (0 is +x, 90 is +z). radiusM, heightM: the level pad, its center at heightM; fallM: how far it falls toward the sea from its center to its seaward edge (and rises to its landward edge), so it sheds rain (F1); blendM: the soft fall back to natural ground; lockFadeM: brushes fade from nothing at the edge to full over this much; dash: the edge drawn on brush contact; wear: the trodden look (0..1) with edgeWearM; grassScale: grass height on the pad. Slots in the pad's frame: u seaward, v left facing the sea. faces: a bench turns so that you work at it facing that slot (front faces: the other way round, its front and where you stand toward that slot, as the clay furnace's arch opens toward the workbench) (the workbench and the apothecary bench face the ring, 3.12); on: it stands on that slot's thing (the mortar on the apothecary bench). mooring: the boat's stake, found by walking out along the facing line to the first ground at stakeLevelM; boatOutM: how far beyond the stake the boat lies on its rope. kingTideMarginM: any king tide must peak this far under heightM. Corners (option A, Matt, October 30, 2026): the fire is the middle; the hearth faces the sea, work (workbench, clay furnace, hamper, piles, the three loose heaps) is on the -v side, herbs (apothecary bench, mortar, rack, dye pot, jar) on the +v side, home (tent, lamp at its door, keepsake shelf, chime off the rack's end) at the back; the animals' things go to the edge (the gift stone on the landward rim, the nest box on the rim toward the hen's bushes, the birdbath off the pad by the bed). yaw inward: turned to face the pad's middle, d toward it and w across (the keepsake shelf); frontM: room kept clear in front of it. rim: placed when made on the pad's rim, rM from the middle, at the bearing of the hen's home bushes or the nearest place gapM clear stepping stepDeg either way up to maxDeg (layout.js rimSpot), saved on its slot record; with no bushes it stands at its own u, v (the home corner). offPad: the slot stands on plain ground just off the pad (the birdbath by the bed). The tests keep every slot apart and on the pad (tools/unit-tests-camp-layout.js).

wearLook.note: The trodden look in terrain-draw.wgsl: wear turns grass to the soil material; albedoLift: packed dry earth reflects this much more than loose soil; dry: share of the wetness it sheds; mossKeep: share of the moss that survives full wear.

story.note: The island's own past under the ground (docs/future/13 10.7.7; src/world/dig/story.js): the starter island always has exactly one old hearth 8 to 20 m from the camp pad and the keeper's cache under one marked stone 12 to 30 m from it. letter: the cache's letter (recipes/world/keeper-cache.json).
